title: Structural insight into the ZFAND1-p97 interaction involved in stress granule clearance.
authors: Lai, Chih-Hsuan; Ko, Kuang-Ting; Fan, Pei-Ju; Yu, Tsun-Ai; Chang, Chi-Fon; Draczkowski, Piotr; Hsu, Shang-Te Danny
one_liner_zh: 该文解析ZFAND1-p97蛋白互作结构，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅结构生物学实验，与本课题无关。
abstract: Arsenite-induced stress granule (SG) formation can be cleared by the ubiquitin-proteasome system aided by the ATP-dependent unfoldase p97. ZFAND1 participates in this pathway by recruiting p97 to trigger SG clearance. ZFAND1 contains two An1-type zinc finger domains (ZF1 and ZF2), followed by a ubiquitin-like domain (UBL); but their structures are not experimentally determined. To shed light on the structural basis of the ZFAND1-p97 interaction, we determined the atomic structures of the individual domains of ZFAND1 by solution-state NMR spectroscopy and X-ray crystallography. We further characterized the interaction between ZFAND1 and p97 by methyl NMR spectroscopy and cryo-EM. (15)N spin relaxation dynamics analysis indicated independent domain motions for ZF1, ZF2, and UBL. The crystal structure and NMR structure of UBL showed a conserved beta-grasp fold homologous to ubiquitin and other UBLs. Nevertheless, the UBL of ZFAND1 contains an additional N-terminal helix that adopts different conformations in the crystalline and solution states. ZFAND1 uses the C-terminal UBL to bind to p97, evidenced by the pronounced line-broadening of the UBL domain during the p97 titration monitored by methyl NMR spectroscopy. ZFAND1 binding induces pronounced conformational heterogeneity in the N-terminal domain of p97, leading to a partial loss of the cryo-EM density of the N-terminal domain of p97. In conclusion, this work paved the way for a better understanding of the interplay between p97 and ZFAND1 in the context of SG clearance.
abstract_zh: 亚砷酸盐诱导的应激颗粒（SG）形成可通过泛素-蛋白酶体系统清除，该系统由ATP依赖性解折叠酶p97辅助。ZFAND1通过招募p97触发SG清除而参与此通路。ZFAND1包含两个An1型锌指结构域（ZF1和ZF2），随后是一个泛素样结构域（UBL）；但其结构尚未通过实验确定。为阐明ZFAND1-p97相互作用的结构基础，我们通过溶液态核磁共振波谱（NMR）和X射线晶体学确定了ZFAND1各结构域的原子结构。我们进一步通过甲基NMR波谱和冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）表征了ZFAND1与p97之间的相互作用。(15)N自旋弛豫动力学分析表明ZF1、ZF2和UBL具有独立的结构域运动。UBL的晶体结构和NMR结构显示其具有与泛素及其他UBL同源的保守β-抓握折叠。然而，ZFAND1的UBL包含一个额外的N端螺旋，该螺旋在晶体态和溶液态中呈现不同构象。ZFAND1通过其C端UBL与p97结合，这由甲基NMR波谱监测p97滴定过程中UBL结构域的显著线宽展宽所证实。ZFAND1结合诱导p97 N端结构域出现显著的构象异质性，导致p97 N端结构域的cryo-EM密度部分丢失。总之，本研究为更好地理解p97与ZFAND1在SG清除过程中的相互作用奠定了基础。
